parsed.explanation: The write-up proves orbit invariance in (4) but never deduces g(x)≥0. Thus “at most one positive value” does not justify V⊆{0,c}; negative values remain possible as written, and Lemma 1 later relies on their exclusion. One sentence suffices: if g(x)=-d<0, repeated use of (4) gives f^n(x)=x-nd>0 for every n, impossible for sufficiently large n.
